## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：总监章程写明，录裁时裁决、正文 `Ruled:` 行和给车道席的 `Notify: ruling` 敲门是同一笔，漏敲是录裁者欠的半状态；半状态巡查新增 H73 行，列出正文已有 `Ruled:` 却仍挂 `needs-user-decision` 超过 6 小时的卡，附裁决 id、已过时长和欠退箱的 `domain:*` 车道席。
- 为什么改：11 月 2 日录裁的 12 张卡，录裁时一次敲门都没有，11 小时后仍全部挂在决策箱里；巡查没有一行读这种情况。
- 风险与回滚：只读巡查，不写任何标签或评论；章程只改一条录裁规则，新增一行由合并 职责一 里两行同义条款付账，仍为 86 行上限。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `h73RuledCardStillInBox`（围栏剥离、取最新时间戳、`Prior rulings on this card:` 重入例外），再看 `lanes/director.md` 第 13 行与第 39 行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`，预期结尾的 battery 列表里有 `H73 ruled card in the decision box 28/25`，且全部通过。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 `.claude/**`（Tier S），由 skills 席复核落地，你无需动作。

## What changes

- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md`** (86 → 86 lines, ceiling unchanged)
  - New line under the `Ruled:` recording line: the `Notify: ruling` knock to the card's lane seat lands in the same act, its shape is the one `../project-forms.md` spells, and a ruling recorded without its knock is a half state the recorder owes. The existing `⛔ 不新增标签与状态` stays, so the director still writes no label on the card.
  - Paid in the same file: the two 职责一 lines 「处理三分支之一,收尾 PASS 且工已完 ⇒ 跟到合并为止」 and 「到合并 = 推进到就绪并点名等待,⛔ 不代维护者合并」 say one thing, and are merged into one line with the same terms. No ceiling raise.
- **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`**: new report-only row **H73**, the body-record half of the runbook's declared 「旗一」.
  - Population: open issues carrying `needs-user-decision`, read on the unscoped open listing beside H62. `needs-user-decision` is not a label page, so this is where those cards are first visible. It is one label read and one body read on rows the sweep already holds, so no new request.
  - Record: a line-leading `Ruled:` (the shared directive reader, so bullet/bold/backtick decoration reads) whose value opens with a numeric comment id. Fenced blocks are stripped first (`stripMarkdownCode`, inline spans kept). A mid-sentence mention and a line-leading `Ruled:` followed by prose are not records.
  - Age: from the newest readable UTC stamp on the card's `Ruled:` lines. A record with no readable stamp reports with its age unreadable, never as fresh. Threshold `RULED_IN_BOX_STALE_HOURS` = 6, one standing patrol cycle (`PATROL_CADENCE_HOURS`).
  - Re-entry: a card whose governing ruling id is named on its `Prior rulings on this card:` line (or the list under it) has lawfully re-entered the box with a new question and is clean.
  - Row text: the ruling comment id, the age against the threshold, the owing `domain:*` lane seat (or "no lane yet, the triage seat routes it"), the one-act rule and the bell shape's printout. No angle brackets, no tracker number.
  - Band `stall`, registered in `HALF_STATE_FAMILY_BAND` with its reasons.
  - Self-test battery `H73 ruled card in the decision box` on the frozen roster (28 cases, pin 25).

## Why

Card #29386, letter A. The director records a ruling as a `Ruling:` comment plus a `Ruled:` body line and writes no label; the exit out of `needs-user-decision` is the lane seat's, and the lane learns of the ruling from a `Notify: ruling` bell. Measured on 2026-11-02, twelve cards ruled 01:14Z–10:06Z drew zero bells and all twelve still carried the label at 12:08Z, the oldest 10 h 54 min after its ruling. No patrol row read a `Ruled:` line against the label.

## Acceptance notes

- **The runbook still says the wiring is another card's.** `dispatch-runbook.md` 「机械两旗 report-only,归半状态巡查;接线是另一张卡的事」 is now half-true for 旗一: its body-record half is H73. The runbook is outside this card's surface and at its own ceiling (245), so it is left for the seat.
- **旗一's title half stays where it was.** A `[Decision]` title is read from the queue side by H54; this row reads only the body record, as the card scopes it.
- **Out of scope as filed:** option B and the reverse direction (a card moved out of the box with no retrievable ruling id), which the runbook assigns to the dispatch-time 决策复读.
- **A live shape this row does not read:** a scoped record such as `Ruled (plugin-ai): ID · letter A · UTC` (one open card carries one, outside the box) is not a line-leading `Ruled:` and is not read. The card specifies `Ruled:`; widening the key is a seat call.

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint over the changed script passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the 维护者速读 section, which the lane asks for in Chinese.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (Left unchecked: the workspace-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` were not run; the changed script has no package tests, and eslint over it was run.)
